what this is about
FIND YOUR KAKI.
MAKE YOUR MOVE.
Kaki Youth Fest integrates multiple experience
tracks under one roof from live performance to brand
activations, food, art, games and community discovery.
JAM KAKI — The performance side. People coming together to make something happen.
KAKI LANG — The activation side. All kinds of people, interests and things to discover.
One destination attracting youth, brands and communities together.
Together these create a one-destination youth experience.
